title: Jesus, My Truth, My Way
description: Jesus, My Truth, My Way in Tonic Solfa to SOUTHWELL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 6 verses and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 373.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to SOUTHWELL; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-sus, my Truth, my Way, My sure un-err-ing Light, On Thee my fee-ble soul I stay, Which Thou wilt lead a-right.

lines: On Thee my feeble soul I stay,
O let me never leave Thy side
My Help and Refuge in distress,
Give me to trust in Thee;
My Horn and Rock and Buckler be,
But strength in Thee I surely have,
Thou, Jesus, having loved Thine own,
Wilt love me to the end!

licence: Public domain: Charles Wesley died in 1788.
credits: Words by Charles Wesley (1707–1788), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to SOUTHWELL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
